d:
Presenting the second video song "Shaitan Ka Saala" from the upcoming Bollywood movie "Housefull 4". The film features Akshay Kumar, Riteish Deshmukh & Bobby Deol as Harry, Roy, & Max respectively who propose their girls Kriti Sanon as Kriti, Pooja Hegde as Pooja & Kriti Kharbanda as Neha in their re-incarnated life in 2019.
Housefull 4 is coming to confuse you, put you on a laughing riot and take you through the grandeur of 1419 with a spark of 2019. Come & witness this Epic Reincarnation Comedy.
Akshay Kumar as Bala & Harry
Riteish Deshmukh as Bangdu Maharaj & Roy
